events.title: Donjek River Camp, YT
events.thought: Camped on a braided glacier bar in the Yukon — blue sky, no fences, just mountains.
events.photoCaption: Waldo fully deployed on the Donjek River bar, snow-capped peaks of the St. Elias Range looming behind.

events.title: Kathleen Lake Reflection, YT
events.thought: Kathleen Lake in the Yukon has no right to be this perfect.
events.photoCaption: Kathleen Lake in perfect reflection — a conical Yukon peak and cirrus sky mirrored in crystal-clear water.
